direct_contact_banner.title: Are you a local tourism business owner?
direct_contact_banner.subtitle: Get listed on CamGO directory for free to receive direct bookings and calls from tourists.

pricing.meta_description: Honest plans for Cambodian tourism businesses. Start free, upgrade to Pro for $10 per month or Premium for $25 per month. No commissions.
pricing.title: Honest pricing. No commissions.
pricing.subtitle: Start free and add visibility when you are ready. Every plan keeps your direct contact channels and never takes a cut of your bookings.
pricing.payment_note: Prices are in USD. Payments are recorded manually by staff after KHQR Bakong or bank transfer. No card is charged on this website, and plans activate only after payment is confirmed.

plans.name: Free
plans.description: A clear, honest listing with the contact details travellers need.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: More room for your story, services, and customer conversations.

plans.name: Premium
plans.description: Stronger placement for businesses that want to be found first.

included.title: Direct contact, always included
included.copy: Every plan includes call, Telegram, WhatsApp, email, and map links. We never hide your contact details behind a booking fee.

trial.title: One 30-day Pro trial
trial.copy: Eligible businesses can try Pro once for 30 days. When the trial ends, you can request a paid plan or continue on Free without losing your data.

verified.title: The badge is not for sale
verified.copy: KYC verification is a separate, free review. A paid plan never grants a verified badge; only a completed KYC review does.

items.question: Do you take a commission from my bookings?
items.answer: No. CamGO Business is a directory, not a booking platform. Travellers contact you directly, and you keep 100% of what you earn.

items.question: Does a paid plan include the verified badge?
items.answer: No. The verified badge is awarded only after a free KYC document review. Plans control visibility and extra tools, not trust badges.

items.question: How do I pay for Pro or Premium?
items.answer: Our team confirms payment by KHQR Bakong or bank transfer and records it manually. Your plan activates once the payment is verified.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes. You can request a different plan from the owner portal. Staff will confirm the change and any payment before it takes effect.

items.question: How do I get an owner account?
items.answer: Business accounts are created by CamGO staff after we verify your business. Use the list-your-business form and our team will guide you through setup.

final.title: Start with a free listing.
final.copy: Send your business details and our team will help you choose the right plan. No commission, no pressure.

list_business.meta_description: Join Cambodia's direct tourism directory. Request a listing for your guesthouse, restaurant, tour, transport, spa, or craft business.
list_business.title: Put your business in front of travellers who contact you directly.
list_business.subtitle: CamGO Business is a directory for licensed Cambodian tourism businesses. We create owner accounts with you, help you prepare an honest profile, and never take a commission.

benefits.no_commission: Keep 100% of your earnings. We do not process bookings or charge commission.
benefits.direct_contact: Travellers call, message, or email you directly from your listing.
benefits.free_start: Start on the Free plan. Upgrade only when you need more visibility or tools.

list_business.note_title: Accounts are created by our team
list_business.note_copy: To keep listings accurate, there is no self-signup. Send the form below and staff will contact you to verify your business before creating your owner account.

form.title: Request a listing review
form.copy: Tell us about your business. We usually reply within one business day.
form.message_placeholder: Category, province, years open, and anything we should know
form.subject: Business listing request
form.error: Could not send your request. Please try again.
form.success_copy: Our team will review your details and contact you about verification and account setup.
form.privacy: We use these details only to review your listing request.

steps.title: Send your details
steps.copy: Share your business name, location, category, and the best way to reach you.

steps.title: Verify the business
steps.copy: Staff confirm your licence, contact channels, and that the listing is genuinely yours.

steps.title: Set up your account
steps.copy: We create your owner account and send a secure setup link by email.

steps.title: Publish and grow
steps.copy: Complete your profile, add photos, and choose a plan when you are ready.

list_business.how_title: From first message to live listing
list_business.how_copy: We keep the process small and human. Most listings can be reviewed once the required details are ready.
checklist: A phone number and Telegram or WhatsApp contact
Two to five clear photos of the business
Opening hours and a short, honest description
Business licence or registration details for KYC
list_business.visit_copy: Call or visit our team if you would rather ask questions in person. We can explain the plans and the KYC review without jargon.
